payload.detail: PARTLY FIXED 2026-09-25 in 8a028a7bf: the /favourites command library tags every demo fixture with an 'Example' chip beside its title (continue strip, recent card, table rows, phone cards) and shows 'Example favourites shown in demo mode' in the header; a clinician's own saved favourites are never tagged (pinned by tests/favourites-auth-gate.dom.test.tsx). Production never shows the fixtures: they are used only when demoMode is true, gated since #871 (541da7b4e). STILL OPEN: the dashboard Favourites hub (favourites-hub.tsx) and the command-surface dropdown (universal-search-command-surface.tsx) still show demo fixtures without an example label.
